row.name: Kid's Cottage Child Development Center, LLC

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A wall in the toddler room was cracked and had missing pieces. Two feather flags with poles were observed on the ground in the outdoor playground. A bbq pit was also observed in the outdoor playground. This posed a safety hazard as the flags and bbq pit were within children's reach.         Note: The feather flags and bbq pit were removed from the outdoor playground during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 1 of 6 personnel records reviewed was missing the employee's Pre-Employment Affidavit (form 2912). 1 of 6 personnel records reviewed was missing  A notarized Affidavit (form 2985).    Note: One employee completed form 2912 during the inspection.
Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 6 children's records reviewed was missing the child's current immunization record.

Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A plastic pot with standing water was observed on the floor in the outdoor playground. A storage bin lid was also observed with standing water.  This posed a safety hazard as the pot and the storage bin were within children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A Merry Go Cycle in the outdoor playground was missing a pedal. This posed as a safety hazard as the metal part of the pedal was exposed and accessible to children.    Note: This was CORRECTED at inspection as the Merry Go Cycle was removed from the outdoor playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A caregiver's purse was observed on top of a children's shelf. This posed a safety hazard as the caregiver's purse was within children's reach.     Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the purse was stored in an area out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: 1 of 3 booster seats was expired in one of the transportation vehicles.     Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the expired booster seat was removed from the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two infants were combined with older children in a toddler room. There was more than an 18 month age difference between the youngest and oldest child in the group. The youngest child was 15 months old and the oldest child was 3 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: There were no activity plans posted in a toddler room and afterschool rooms. The activity plans posted in the infant room and pre-k room were not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required: There was no additional employee present in the building during the naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Upon arrival to the operation a group of children of varying ages including a 14 month old infant were observed watching a movie during the naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: A 4 month old infant was observed asleep in a restrictive d evice (swing) for an undetermined amount of time.         Note: This was addressed with the caregivers during inspectoin and the infant was moved to their assigned crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: There was more than an 18 month age difference between the youngest and oldest child in a group when an infant was combined with older children. The infant was 14 months of age and the oldest child in the group was 10 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Three infants were left unsupervised for an undetermined amount of time when the caregiver in charge of the group of children was observed in the office area with two other employees upon CCR s arrival to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A hole was observed on a wall leading to a toddler room. A door to a storage area was broken off in the outdoor playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: A caregiver caring for a group of children did not have training in Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))
